name: 24-Hour Channel Trend Breakout
hypothesis: A fresh M15 close beyond the prior 24-hour range in the H4 EMA-trend direction resumes the higher-timeframe trend; a wide 1.5 H1-ATR stop tolerates M15 noise.
risk_model: One planned risk unit; 1.5 H1 ATR(24) stop; 2.5R objective; exit by min(24h, next broker gap).
known_limitations: No verified edge. M15 both-barrier candles need M1 (only since Jul 2026) and are otherwise AMBIGUOUS; CFD spread proxies; correlated instruments; broker holiday calendar unverified. v0.2.0 instrument subset selected from v0.1.0 training results (selection bias); v0.1.0 rejected at -0.057R over 3,186 trades.
